title: Upstream crosslink observation: /design --continue unconditionally resets pipeline.json (stage designed, plans/runs wiped)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DETAIL (crosslink @ 6b4f736f): the /design skill's 'Pipeline State Initialization' heredoc (resources/claude/commands/design.md:163-181) unconditionally writes stage:'designed', plans:[], runs:[] on EVERY invocation — including --continue on a design whose pipeline has advanced. Consequence: resuming iteration on a planned/running design wipes its plan/run history and regresses its stage. The Rust side is fine (design_cmd.rs never touches pipeline.json; kickoff's ensure_pipeline_state creates-if-absent only). Fix direction: the skill should preserve an existing pipeline.json's stage/plans/runs and update only doc_hash.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Rolled into the kickoff epic: https://github.com/magnificentlycursed/crosslink/issues/2 (tracks the full vsdd kickoff bundle with upstream dollspace-gay/crosslink links; check-off happens there as upstream fixes land).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSED (tracked upstream): filed as dollspace-gay/crosslink#56, fix in flight (their PR #65); epic magnificentlycursed/crosslink#2 tracks. The lifecycle-member interaction (the --continue heredoc vs the sanctioned amend path) is codified in the contract's Design-doc lifecycle member.
